title: Omniprediction with the Minimum Number of Linear Scores
abstract: arXiv:2611.30625v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An $\varepsilon$-omnipredictor uses one forecast for an entire family of downstream losses. After postprocessing for each loss, its expected loss must be at most $\varepsilon$ above that of the best comparator for that loss. A binary single-index model (SIM) learns a norm-bounded weight vector $w$ and a nondecreasing link $\rho$. It reduces the features $x$ to one linear score $w^\top x$, then maps that score to a probability $p(x)=\rho(w^\top x)$. Hu, Tian, and Yang (STOC 2025) achieved $\varepsilon$-omniprediction for binary matching losses using $O(1/\varepsilon^2)$ SIMs and asked whether one SIM suffices. In the population model, we prove that one SIM suffices for exact omniprediction in their bounded-action setting. The result holds for any compact family of continuous nondecreasing target links.   With unrestricted actions and matching losses generated by $1/\beta$-strongly convex entropies, the SIM's link can also be $\beta$-Lipsc

translated_title: 用最少数量线性分数实现全能预测
translated_abstract: 一个 ε-全能预测器使用单一预测来应对整个下游损失函数族。在针对每个损失进行后处理后，其期望损失必须至多比该损失的最优比较对象高出 ε。二值单指标模型学习一个范数有界的权重向量 w 和一个非递减的链接函数 ρ。它将特征 x 简化为一个线性分数 w^T x，再将该分数映射为概率 p(x)=ρ(w^T x)。Hu、Tian 和 Yang（STOC 2025）使用 O(1/ε²) 个单指标模型实现了针对二值匹配损失的 ε-全能预测，并提出单个单指标模型是否足够的开放问题。在总体模型中，我们证明了在他们的有界动作设定下，单个单指标模型即可实现精确的全能预测，且该结果对任意紧致的连续非递减目标链接函数族均成立。在动作不受限制以及匹配损失由 1/β-强凸熵生成的情况下，单指标模型的链接函数还可以是 β-Lipschitz 的。
tldr: 本文证明了在总体模型的有界动作设定下，仅需单个单指标模型即可实现精确的全能预测，解决了 Hu 等人（STOC 2025）提出的关于是否可用一个模型替代 O(1/ε²) 个模型的开放问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that a single single-index model (SIM) suffices for exact omniprediction in the population model's bounded-action setting, resolving the open question raised by Hu, Tian, and Yang (STOC 2025), who had required O(1/ε²) SIMs.
